name: America VS America 美国反对美国
detailed_description:
Choose to play as Trump or Biden and join the 2024 U.S. presidential election. Use cards to control swing states and secure electoral votes—once you exceed 270 votes, you win the election. You can simply allocate a card’s points to a state, or you can activate the card’s special effects.

Propaganda Cards

Border lockdowns, major hurricanes, political correctness—various event cards bring diverse effects! Every month, all placed propaganda cards are cleared from both sides, and a newspaper issue is published to recap all the propaganda events of the month。

Policy Cards

Policy card effects persist throughout the game! Different policy cards can be combined, and each combination offers a unique experience and can be the key to turning the tide of the campaign.

Conspiracy Cards

Use your conspiracy cards to delay and trigger special event effects. You can also try to uncover your opponent’s conspiracy cards. There’s always a surprise waiting for you here.

Embark on your journey! Join the election camp of your choice, experience the events of election year firsthand, and bring America to the outcome you desire!

short_description: American vs. America is a card-based political simulation game themed around the 2024 U.S. presidential election. Choose your faction and play a wide variety of election-year event cards to shape your own unique election outcome.
